The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: antecedent witness is the Mame, Tours 1922 (editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam); 96% of the 1962 body's tokens align in order after canon folding; the witness text layer damages 'intercessidne' where the 1962 prints 'intercessione'; the Mame prints j where the 1962 prints i (Iesum/Jesum, eius/ejus) and its recogniser renders the ae ligature as 'z' or 'e'; both are orthographic; pointing: the antecedent's reading is recorded verbatim above so its commas and colons can be compared, but its punctuation is NOT safely collatable - the recogniser turns commas into full stops, semicolons and question marks - so no punctuation difference here should be read as a difference between the printings; the 1962 prints the conclusion as 'Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.'; conclusion length was excluded from the alignment and is recorded here as printed, per the settled rule. Corroboration: Pustet 1862 text-layer lines 78345-78353 (73% coverage); Venice 1570 at line 71936 (46%; degraded, corroboration only); Benziger 1962 conformed printing at line 99812 (68%; comparison only, never a publication basis).

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui conspicis, quia ex nulla nostra virtute subsistimus: concede
propitius; ut, intercessione beati Martini Confessoris tui atque Pontificis,
contra omnia adversa muniamur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium
tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Sanctifica, quaesumus, Domine Deus, haec munera, quae in solemnitate sancti
Antistitis tui Martini offerimus: ut per ea vita nostra inter adversa et
prospera ubique dirigatur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum:
Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Praesta, quaesumus, Domine Deus noster: ut, quorum festivitate votiva sunt
sacramenta, eorum intercessione salutaria nobis reddantur. Per Dominum
nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.
